cars.generation: Second-generation S130 / Datsun 280ZX sporting-GT road family
cars.variant: Fairlady 280Z-T two-seat T-top — 1982 HS130 heritage reference
cars.specification_market: Manufacturer’s own 1982 HS130 two-seater. The page dates S130’s full-model change to 1978 and identifies the overseas 280ZX name. T denotes the T-top here, not a turbo: L28E is not L28ET. No US emissions tune, turbo output, 2+2 body or unlisted transmission is inferred. The first-T-top statement refers to Japan and this programme. One S130 family is counted.
cars.summary: The S130 is a foundational Z-car grand-tourer, carrying the original sports-car identity into a distinct second generation. Nissan’s preserved two-seater documents Japan’s first T-top offering, an important open-roof engineering development in the Z’s lasting international sporting-GT story.
